root_cause_criterion.obligation: buf must be zero-initialized at declaration so that all bytes are defined before the compiler-optimized memcmp reads them, regardless of how many bytes the parser loop writes
root_cause_criterion.fix_mechanism: zero-initialization of buf at declaration (char buf[kMaxSignatureAlgorithmNameLen] = {}) ensures all bytes are defined regardless of buf_used value

nodes.description: The compiler-optimized memcmp at the ECDSA strcmp reads 6 bytes unconditionally; when init_len (buf_used+1) < read_len (6), uninitialized stack bytes are consumed

edges.description: Buffer capacity (23 bytes) exceeds the initialized portion (buf_used+1 bytes), proving an uninitialized gap exists between declaration and the comparison point
The partial-initialization boundary (buf_used) propagates unchanged from null-termination to the memcmp-optimized comparison, carrying the insufficient fill state to the sink
